decision.reason: [ev-4a489b1e9ff3] says only that the Traefik option `tracing.datadog.globaltag` "has been removed" in the v2-to-v3 migration guide. It does not say where this option is set, such as a configuration file, a CLI argument or an environment variable. It also never mentions Helm values. The proposed values-key exposure looks for this path in Helm values, and nothing in the evidence supports that, so it may miss every environment that is actually exposed. To choose correct predicates we need evidence showing how the option is set, for example its CLI flag or environment-variable form or a Helm chart values key.
